The color of an eggplant is purple.

The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalization directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for our customers. This strategy likely increases customer lifetime value for them while directly eroding our market share. To counter this, we must urgently evaluate our own retention strategies, potentially by enhancing our digital engagement, offering competitive incentives, or differentiating our brand value proposition beyond price and rewards.
